allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable consolidated blood-products revenue and actual product sales volumes; station count, plasma collection, plasma input and nameplate capacity are explanatory only
consolidated operating profit, revenue, recurring operating margin and parent adjusted net profit
selling expense, administrative expense, expensed and capitalized R&D, depreciation, plasma-collection cost, inventory and impairment
government grants, other income, disposal, investment income, non-operating items and terminated-R&D charges needed to separate nonrecurring effects
accounting-policy, consolidation-perimeter, product-classification or common-control changes needed for comparability
consolidated operating cash flow and cash paid to acquire fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets
inventory and working-capital explanation and unfinished necessary capital commitments
Chengdu Rongsheng and other material NCI post-capex cash attribution, required retention or reinvestment, and NCI distributions where disclosed
actual non-financing upstream cash received by the listed-company parent, net parent support to subsidiaries, parent necessary expenses and announced common-shareholder distributions
parent liquidity and any legal, regulatory, shareholder-agreement or financing-contract restriction on upstream cash
cash-flow classification, consolidation-perimeter, term-deposit or capital-expenditure definition changes needed for comparability

formulas.group_cash_proxy: consolidated operating cash flow minus cash paid to acquire fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets
formulas.parent_distributable_cash: material subsidiary post-capex cash minus NCI claims and required retention or reinvestment, reconciled to actual non-financing parent receipts and net parent support

allowed_fields: issuer disclosures on product recalls, batch release, shutdowns, GMP inspections or major deficiencies, administrative penalties, plasma-station licence suspension or revocation, and serious product-safety events
the affected production entity, product, material plasma-station network and economic materiality
remediation completion, production or collection restart, later batch release, licence validity, recertification requirement, cross-period supply interruption and sustained trust damage
continuing remediation capital or expense, fixed cost during shutdown, and affected recurring-profit contribution where disclosed
event-boundary or event-definition changes needed for comparability

output_requirements: Record every raw reported value, unit, responsibility boundary, printed page and source locator before derived values.
Apply every frozen first-match in order and identify the unique matched class; apply the frozen cross-cell aggregation only after all three local cells are settled.
Keep revenue and product sales together with recurring profit and persistent costs; never use plasma stations, plasma collection, plasma input or nameplate capacity alone as economic absorption.
Keep group cash, NCI attribution and parent access separate; partial scope closure stays conditional and must not erase the observed group-cash direction.

For a quality event, distinguish an observed complete severe path, a verified in-period recovery path, a contained path and genuinely unresolved persistence. Missing an unrelated field must not erase a complete adverse path.
Keep UNKNOWN and measurement mismatch local and continue settling all other observable cells.
Do not infer management quality, enterprise conclusions, training utility, valuation, price, return or investment action.
forbidden_inputs: any prior Teaching case, Blind feedback, candidate method or transfer rule
the holdout preoutcome narrative or treatment mapping beyond this explicit cell contract and frozen references
any source other than the single authorized official FY2024 annual report
